rows.exact_equality_finding: NOT GUARANTEED IN GENERAL. assert_exact uses torch.equal / np.array_equal with ZERO numerical tolerance (no allclose/isclose/atol/rtol). Exact equality is REQUIRED, and holds for this synthetic batch only because both arms share identical weights, dtype, device and deterministic execution. FullPackageRuntime reuses canonical FamilyBundle.load + build_gtfree rather than reimplementing inference. Any precision divergence (CPU vs CUDA, TF32/AMP, float16 serialisation, differing reduction order) is REJECTED with ArtifactError rather than quantified; a 1e-6 perturbation and a float16 round-trip are both demonstrated to be rejected. validate_control_batch labels success BIT_EXACT unconditionally: this is an observation on the observed control batch, not a guarantee.
